description:
Browse open-source bots with normalized stats and capacity info.

    NOTE: personal funds can only contain the authenticated user's OWN
    bots — use list_my_bots for roster-eligible strategies. This tool is
    for researching the broader bot ecosystem.

    Args:
        domain: Filter by domain (e.g. "eth_usdc").

    Returns a JSON array of bot entries with gamified card ratings.
name: list_open_source_bots
